moments.author: Brad Miska
moments.quote: Your Halloween watchlist has a surprise addition. ‘IT: WELCOME TO DERRY’ has released ‘A STORY OF DERRY,’ a 30‑minute special exploring the ancient horror that predates Pennywise. Streaming now on HBO Max. Watch the trailer: [link]
moments.why: It went viral because the surprise drop of a new Halloween episode from a popular horror prequel caught fans off‑guard and ignited buzz online.

moments.author: Bloody Disgusting
moments.quote: A surprise Halloween treat from HBO Max... A brand new bonus episode of IT: WELCOME TO DERRY, titled A STORY OF DERRY, is now streaming. The never‑before‑seen special explores the origins of IT in Derry.
moments.why: The tweet spread quickly because it amplified the unexpected release of the spooky special through a respected horror media outlet.
